message: Verdant 15.4.6 restores the package menu by removing UdonSharp-unsupported runtime code and adds an independent bootstrap menu that does not depend on Verdant Runtime.
notes: Removed generic List<T> usage from UdonSharp runtime clock code.
Removed Input.mouseScrollDelta from the UdonSharp supporter scroll keeper.
Dropdown option analysis now happens in the Editor installer and passes simple integer arrays into runtime.
Added an independent Verdant.Menu Editor assembly so Diagnostics > Package Status can load without Verdant Runtime.
Retains the 15.4.4 assembly definitions, UdonSharp registration and VerdantRoleAuthority repair.
Keeps the 15.4.5 direct clock/version repair and smoother supporter scrolling.
